_comment: Defaults for tools\loadtest. Every value here can be overridden on the command line; see README.md.
_spread: Where the bots play. 'arrival' is the Pale Pass spot every hub gate leads to (gamemode-config.json playtest.arrival); 'city' is Bruma itself, which is where a hundred players would actually be. groundZ is approximate on purpose: the server has no ground.
_dungeons: Dungeons a claimer bot may take. Entrance data comes from server\dungeons.json; these are Bruma-world entrances with room for a party.
